title: Zesty Claypot Middle Eastern Eggs Shakshuka
description: A flavorful and nutritious Shakshuka recipe made with fresh eggs, spices, and vegetables in a claypot, perfect for a date night dinner.

ingredients.name: 4-6 cookies
ingredients.notes: such as biscotti or amaretti, crushed for topping

instructions: Heat the claypot over medium heat on the stovetop, then add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, red bell pepper, cumin, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper to the claypot, and cook for another 5 minutes.
Add the crushed tomatoes to the claypot and stir to combine.
Create 4 wells in the tomato mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Transfer the claypot to the preheated oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until the eggs are set and the whites are cooked through.
Sprinkle the crushed cookies over the top of the eggs and return the claypot to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cookies are lightly toasted.
Remove the claypot from the oven and let it cool slightly before serving.
